No editor control for image or new refresh/render/retry button. No preview-unavailable copy because preview exists. Preserve full owner host, screenshot-derived sidebar content and source-derived dirty indicator/hint only, no new data/capabilities/protocol inputs. This is one coherent last-complete-PNG state.
